# Release Notes

## 0.41.0 - 2026-10-19 (deployed)

Production deployment run `39289922585` completed successfully from SHA `da885d1327cdd068357786f20415a207b900a0a9` on **2026-10-19**. This release adds the goals lifecycle and scoped transaction-history behavior described below. This record documents the deployed runtime and verification boundary; it does **not** claim production acceptance complete.

Goals now create a dedicated account atomically per goal. Goal details expose explicit actions, including funding and spending. Spending uses the full funded goal-account balance as one ordinary expense; completing a goal preserves its funds/account, marks the goal complete, and prevents repeat completion. Transactions and transfer history are scoped to the relevant server-authoritative finance scope.

Verification boundary: the successful production deployment run is recorded above. Authenticated goal `test 22`, target `9998` remains unverified and is explicitly deferred by user request. No production acceptance claim is made for that deferred check. Existing historical release warnings and incomplete-acceptance records remain unchanged.

This reviewed documentation sync updates canonical version/release/current-state documentation; no runtime redeploy is implied.

Last updated: 2026-10-19
